On YouTube, you can find his tutorials—how to shoot and vacuum-pack squab, or ferment pickles.

“These days, Shelter has become popular all over again, especially with twenty to thirty-year-olds who need a place to live and don’t want to get involved with banks or debt-saddling landlords and high rents,” Kahn wrote in the 2017 edition. “Even with all the changes in these [intervening] years—the book is the same, and the message is the same: Do what you can for yourself.
